subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 17,200 is lent out at simple interest in two parts for two years at 8% and 10% p.a., respectively. If the total interest received after two years is Rs. 3,008, then the money lent at 8% rate is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 17,200

Rate = 8% and 10%

The total interest received after two years = Rs. 3,008

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the amount lent on 8% be x.

Then, the amount lent on 10% be (17,200 – x)

So, Interest on first part = (x × 8 × 2)/100

And, Interest on second part = [(17,200 – x) × 10 × 2/100]

Now,

⇒ (x × 8 × 2)/100 + [(17,200 – x) × 10 × 2/100] = 3,008

⇒ 16x/100 + 344,000 – 20x/100 = 3,008

⇒ (16x + 344,000 – 20x) = 3,008 × 100

⇒ (16x + 344,000 – 20x) = 300,800

⇒ (20x – 16x) = (344,000 – 300,800)

⇒ 4x = 43,200

⇒ x = (43,200/4)

⇒ x = Rs. 10,800

Now,

The money lent on 8% = x = Rs. 10,800

**∴ The required money is Rs. 10,800**
